rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLL"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:

        $c = "WSASocket" wide ascii
        $d = "HttpSendRequest" wide ascii
        $e = "kernel32.dll" wide ascii
    condition:
        $a at 0 and all of ($b..$e)
}

arguments.summary: A critical ransomware incident was initiated through a phishing compromise on workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). The attacker performed reconnaissance, conducted lateral movement via SMB to multiple internal hosts, and attempted Kerberos TGT requests. The domain controller (10.0.1.50) was targeted for lateral movement. Immediate containment actions included blocking the source IP at the firewall and executing a remediation playbook to isolate and clean the infected host. No evidence of ransomware encryption was found during remediation, indicating successful early intervention.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacons using dynamic API loading patterns"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2"
    strings:
        $api_load = { 8B ?? 24 ?? 8B ?? 1C ?? 8B ?? 04 ?? C1 ?? 05 } // Common pattern for GetProcAddress + LoadLibrary
        $config_marker = "beacon" wide ascii
        $c2_uri = "task" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        $api_load and
        $config_marker and
        $c2_uri
}
